{{Quote|Exactly fifty-two minutes ago, a Republic spy infiltrated an Imperial capital ship. The blast-happy scum killed sixteen loyal officers and made off with a sample of our most deadly bioweapon.|Captain [[Jaggard]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''spy''' in the employ of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] infiltrated an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Imperial]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] sixteen Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and stealing a sample of a deadly bioweapon. The spy escaped to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], but was injured in the crash and died soon after hiding the sample. His efforts would prove to be in vain, as the Imperials managed to locate the spy's remains first and recover the bioweapon sample.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic spy's body appears in the mission "Biohazard" for players on the Imperial version of Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
